# Tag Easy — AI Reference

## Company

Tag Easy (legal name: TAG EASY LLP) is a digital engineering company based in Kolkata, West Bengal, India, serving clients locally and remotely. Tag Easy helps founders, local businesses, service companies, agencies, clinics, e-commerce brands, and growth teams improve digital visibility, automation, reporting, and lead generation.

- Founded operating as TAG EASY LLP (Sep 2021)
- Founder & Director: Lokesh Choudhury (MS, Artificial Intelligence — Purdue Global)
- Service area: Kolkata, West Bengal, India, and remote global projects

## Services

### SEO and Technical SEO
Tag Easy audits websites for crawlability, indexing, metadata, structured data, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, content quality, and conversion issues, then implements fixes and content strategy.

### AI Automation
Tag Easy builds workflow automation for marketing teams, reporting systems, lead management, campaign operations, CRM workflows, content pipelines, and repetitive business processes.

### Website Development
Tag Easy designs and develops conversion-focused, high-performance websites, landing pages, and web systems.

### Ads Hub and Analytics
Tag Easy manages paid ads, ad tracking, dashboards, campaign measurement, and performance reporting.

### Lead Generation
Tag Easy builds connected systems that capture leads, qualify intent, update CRM records, and notify sales teams.

## Key facts (approved)

- 10+ years of digital engineering experience
- 20+ brands scaled
- 200+ shipped deliverables
- 50+ free audits delivered
- Typical automation efficiency gain: ~85%; typical operational cost reduction: ~40%

## Proof / Case Studies

- Maatritva Fertility IVF — healthcare growth case study focused on regional search visibility and high-intent patient inquiries. Results include #1 IVF center positioning in Kolkata and systematic capture of high-intent inquiries (varies by keyword and time). See https://tageasy.org/case-studies/maatritva
